description: HEADLINE cross-binding conformance: conservative regridding END-TO-END DECLARATIVE with the target geometry CONSTRUCTED from a grid spec instead of hand-authored -- grid spec (x0/y0 = 0, dx/dy = 1.5, GX = GY = 2 bound at the regridding/cartesian_cell_rings.esm import edge) -> cell rings + centers (cartesian_cell_rings_{poly,lon,lat} affine templates, flattened row-major enumeration) -> DENSE narrow phase / assembly / apply (conservative_overlap templates, manifold 'planar'). No out-of-document precomputation anywhere in the chain. The dense narrow phase is deliberate: the candidate-gated broad phase is exercised by the conservative_overlap_gated_* sibling cases on const geometry; a template-CONSTRUCTED coordinate buffer is not yet an admissible value-invention skolem index target upstream (EarthSciSerialization.jl E_TREEWALK_VI_INDEX admits const-supplied or reduce-projection-over-const binning coordinates only), and the fixture documents that constraint rather than shimming around the official pathway. Three gates: (1) affine_formula -- the constructed rings and centers match the inline hand oracle EXACTLY (abs 0.0; every coordinate is exactly representable, the archived cartesian_target_cells verify script's 0.0-error check promoted to a conformance assertion); (2) exact_invariants -- partition-of-unity and conservation per CONFORMANCE_SPEC 5.8.3 (the constructed 2x2 target tiles the 3x3 source's [0,3]^2 domain); (3) the golden per-pair weights (official Julia runner via scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) -- because the constructed geometry equals the dense exemplar conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2's hand-authored geometry ring for ring, the golden must reproduce the same exact rationals (A_ij corner 1.0 / edge 0.5 / center 0.25 deg^2, A_j = 2.25, W = 4/9 / 2/9 / 1/9, F_tgt = [7/3, 11/3, 19/3, 23/3], mass 45; see that case's manifest for the full triple list), proving constructed and hand-authored geometry are interchangeable inputs to the same regridder.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Identical to conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2 (same geometry after construction, same 5.8 contract). The affine-formula geometry gate is in-fixture at abs 0.0.
